Implement and uphold organizational policies and procedures, integrating sustainable consumption practices into daily operations.
Actively engage in enhancing organizational performance by driving the transition towards environmentally friendly processes and practices.
Safely handle materials, equipment, computers, and software to maintain a clean and hazard-free work environment, actively supporting the adoption of eco-friendly practices throughout the workplace.

Immediately report any instances of unsafe equipment or hazardous incidents to the appropriate personnel to ensure swift resolution and mitigate risks.
